title: Cacnea 57/100 Pokemon EX Sandstorm 2003 e-Reader Poison Payback Basic Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Cacnea – Pokemon EX Sandstorm – 57/100
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front and back both shown.
Card details
Name: Cacnea (Basic, Grass)
50 HP
Set: EX Sandstorm (2003)
Card number: 57/100
Rarity: Common – standard non-holo
Illustrator: Atsuko Nishida
e-Reader dot code: XR1-PAX-TE5
Card ID: I-05
Copyright: © 2003 Pokemon / Nintendo
Poke-BODY – Poison Payback:
If Cacnea is your Active Pokemon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if Cacnea is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokemon is now Poisoned.
Attack:
Light Punch (Colorless) – 10 damage
Weakness: Fire. Resistance: none. Retreat cost: 1.
This is from the e-Reader era, with the dot code strip along the card edge – the run of EX-series cards that could be scanned with the Game Boy Advance e-Reader.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review both photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition.
